mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which is likely to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following a low FEDFUNDS signal, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which is typically associated with economic growth and higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when UNRATE is below 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing real sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is likely to drive corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following increasing RSAFS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a slowdown in economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when INDPRO growth is negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) show simultaneous growth, it indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of the 60-day periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are growing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low, it creates a favorable environment for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low interest rate and high growth regime
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the 20-day periods when GDPC1 growth is strong and FEDFUNDS is low, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth, as indicated by PAYEMS, suggests a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the 5-day periods following strong PAYEMS growth, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) are increasing, it indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of the 60-day periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST are growing, the hypothesis is rejected.
